entities.name: Jiří Kodl
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jiří Kodl was a Czech tennis player. He competed for Bohemia in the men's outdoor singles event at the 1912 Summer Olympics. He was the flag bearer for Bohemia at the 1912 Games.
